title: Vegetable Kasha
description: A simple and healthy Japanese-inspired vegetarian pilaf dish made with vegetable broth, nourishing vegetables, and pilaf.
instructions: Heat sesame oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add carrots and green onions, cook for 5 minutes.
Add pilaf and vegetable broth to the saucepan.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and cover.
Simmer for 20 minutes or until the pilaf is tender.
Stir in soy sauce and sesame seeds.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
